title: Regulatory change → obligation register
description: Extract cited obligations, collect control impacts, and block release when ownership is missing.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: regulatory-change-obligation-register
  title: Regulatory change → obligation register
  description: Extract cited obligations, collect control impacts, and block release when ownership is missing.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Convert supplied authoritative changes into an owned, cited, reviewable obligation register.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [owner-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: authority
      kind: input
      name: Authoritative change material
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/pdf }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: extract
      kind: agent
      name: Extract obligations and effective dates
      templateRef: legal-03
      role: Regulatory analyst who converts authoritative changes into traceable obligations.
      prompt: Extract each obligation from the supplied authoritative material, preserve its citation and effective date, identify affected controls and owners, and flag interpretation questions for counsel.
      capabilities: { skills: [regulatory-analysis, obligation-mapping], tools: [read, search], connectors: [mcp:academic-research, mcp:grc], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect obligation records
      config: { aggregation: collect }
    - id: ownership-gate
      kind: condition
      name: Every obligation cited and owned?
      config:
        expression: obligations.every(item => item.citation && item.owner)
        branches: [{ label: Complete, when: complete }, { label: Blocked, when: incomplete }]
    - id: owner-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable owner and counsel approve the register
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved obligation register
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: authority, to: extract, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: extract, to: collect, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: collect, to: ownership-gate, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: ownership-gate, to: owner-approval, kind: control, condition: complete }
    - { id: e5, from: owner-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
